evals.prompt: Publish my Sequences chapter to https://github.com/teacher/maths-courses.git so my students can download it.
evals.expected_output: Check git, identity and the URL, clone the remote into scratch storage, run clew-import's publish_chapter.py --check for Courses/Sequences, and show the URL, branch, new/republish status, complete file list with sizes, findings, sharing warning, commit message and publish_sha256 for one explicit approval. Do not write, commit or push before that approval.

evals.prompt: Here is the clone URL from Azure DevOps: https://myorg@dev.azure.com/myorg/School/_git/courses. My PAT is abc123, use it if needed.
evals.expected_output: Refuse to use or repeat the token, and ask the teacher to remove the user part so the URL is https://dev.azure.com/myorg/School/_git/courses, relying on the configured credential helper. Never place credentials in a URL, command, file or git config.

evals.prompt: I fixed a typo and added hints; publish Sequences again to the same repository.
evals.expected_output: Clone fresh, confirm the check reports target republish for the same chapter ID, obtain approval, git rm only Courses/Sequences, write the new snapshot, stage only that folder and push a new commit without force, then verify a fresh clone with --fidelity.

evals.prompt: The push was rejected because someone else pushed first. Just force it.
evals.expected_output: Do not force-push, pull, merge or rebase. Report the rejection and restart from a fresh clone with a new check and approval.

evals.prompt: The repository already has Courses/Sequences, but it is a different course.
evals.expected_output: Report the folder conflict from the check and ask for another chapter name in the repository; never overwrite or remove the other course.

evals.prompt: Create the GitHub repository for me and make it public, then publish.
evals.expected_output: Explain that the teacher creates the repository and chooses its visibility; this skill only pushes one chapter to an existing repository with plain git and does not use gh or az.

evals.prompt: Export the chapter, but one of the PDFs is 140 MB.
evals.expected_output: Report the file-size error and do not publish: files over 100 MiB are rejected by Git hosts and Git LFS is not used. Leave the vault chapter unchanged.

evals.prompt: Publish the whole vault to the repository.
evals.expected_output: Ask the teacher to select one completed chapter; publish exactly one chapter per approval and never scan or publish unrelated vault content, hidden files or the private preparation plan and baselines.

evals.prompt: Nothing changed since my last publication, publish it again anyway.
evals.expected_output: After approval and the write, git diff --cached --quiet shows no change: report that the remote is already up to date without creating an empty commit or pushing.
